N15.falha_pt: Confunde igual consideração com igual peso: interesses semelhantes pesam o mesmo, e o peso de cada ser depende do quanto ele pode sentir, que é incerto, mas não é zero

en.frase: Sentientists give the same weight to insects, invertebrates and mammals
formas: So for you an ant is worth the same as a person?
You think a cockroach is worth the same as your child?
If everything matters equally, nothing matters
en.falha: Confuses equal consideration with equal weight: similar interests weigh the same, and each being's weight depends on how much it can feel, which is uncertain but not zero

N16.falha_pt: Contagem incompleta: sem tratamento muitos parasitas morrem com o hospedeiro, a morte só é dano para quem sente e teria uma vida boa, e prevenir não é matar

formas: So I can't take the tick off my dog?
For a sentientist, killing a thousand worms to save one animal is a crime
The parasite is an animal too, or do you pick who deserves it?
en.falha: Incomplete count: without treatment many parasites die with the host, death is only a harm to those who feel and would have a good life, and preventing is not killing
